items.context: A notice at the public library

items.prompt: The library will be closed ___ Monday 3 March because of repair work.

explanation.en: We use on with days and dates.

items.prompt: There are only ___ computers in the reading room, so please book a slot in advance.

explanation.en: Computers can be counted, so we use a few. A little and much go with uncountable nouns.
explanation.es: «Computers» es contable: a few. «A little» y «much» son para incontables.

items.prompt: Staff are happy to help ___ you have trouble with the self-service machines.

explanation.en: If introduces the condition under which staff will help. Unless and until do not make sense here.

items.prompt: The café on the first floor is ___ every day from nine until five.

explanation.en: Open is the adjective meaning not closed. Opened describes an action, as in it was opened by the mayor.

items.prompt: We apologise for any ___ this may cause.

explanation.en: After any we need a noun. The usual phrase is any inconvenience.
